title: Ubuntu on Windows for Computational Biology
author: James P B Lloyd
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sfuebnw
materials: Given that a lot of the software and code used is from Python version 2.7, it is worth having a legacy version around. To install Python 2.7, use apt-get like so: $ sudo apt install python This will ask for the password that you set Ubuntu up with.

steps.title: Verify Windows Version
steps.instruction: Ensure Windows 10 has the 2018 Fall Creators update (version 1709 or greater).

steps.title: Enable Windows Subsystem for Linux
steps.instruction: Enable the WSL feature in Windows settings.

substeps.instruction: Open the Start menu and search for 'Windows Features'.
Click 'Turn Windows Features on or off'.
Locate 'Windows Subsystems for Linux' and check the box to enable it.

steps.title: Install Ubuntu App
steps.instruction: Download and initialize the Ubuntu application.

substeps.instruction: Download the Ubuntu app from the Windows App store.
Open the app to begin the installation process.
Set a username and passphrase when prompted.

steps.title: Verify Ubuntu Installation
steps.instruction: Check the installed Ubuntu version using the terminal.

steps.title: Update Ubuntu OS
steps.instruction: Update and upgrade the Ubuntu operating system using superuser privileges.

steps.title: Install Python Development Tools
steps.instruction: Install essential build and development tools for Python.

steps.title: Install Pip Package Managers
steps.instruction: Install pip for both Python 2 and Python 3 to manage Python modules.

steps.title: Install Pandas
steps.instruction: Install the pandas library via apt-get to automatically include dependencies like numpy and matplotlib.

steps.title: Upgrade SciPy
steps.instruction: Upgrade SciPy to the latest version (1.0.0) using pip for both Python versions.

substeps.instruction: Upgrade Python 2 SciPy: $ sudo pip install scipy --upgrade
Upgrade Python 3 SciPy: $ sudo pip3 install scipy --upgrade

steps.title: Install Salmon Binary
steps.instruction: Download and extract the Salmon RNA-seq quantification software binary.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the local bin directory: $ cd /usr/local/bin
Extract the archive: $ sudo tar -xvzf Salmon-0.8.2_linux_x86_64.tar.gz

steps.title: Run Salmon
steps.instruction: Execute Salmon by calling the full path to the binary.
